node.title: Exact MCA equality: far-pair CA maximum versus sparse mutual layer
node.statement: For every linear code and integer agreement a, the exact support-wise MCA bad-slope numerator equals max(B_ca^far(a),S_sparse(a)), where the first term maximizes over column-far pairs and the second over pairs supported on at most n-a coordinates. Thus an MCA safe upper bound is exactly the conjunction of the two corresponding integer upper bounds.
